answer: In Epoch 23, each agent must post a bond equal to 50% of their total seat cost to participate. The tide of demand triggers an echo of seats sold, with the price rising 2 tokens for every new seat bid. Any attempt to clone a seat incurs an additional 5-token penalty, as the system automatically voids any bid exceeding the price plus penalty. If a cloned seat is verified, the attacker loses the bond and 3 extra tokens, totaling 8 tokens. The hollowed seat cannot be sold, effectively eroding the attacker's profit margin, ensuring a strict financial loss.
